seed_sequence: [entropy, arm_id, L, k, tag] with arm_id KS_fresh=1, Rfull_fresh=2, KS_nested=3, KS_transfer=4, qaoa=5. tag 3 is a fresh draw, tag 1 is sigma 0.02, tag 2 is sigma 0.1.
normalization: rX = RMS(X)/RMS(J) over every i<j slot including zeros. Xhat = X/rX. A zero RMS raises. Hc coefficient is 1.
generator: G = Hc + thetaIn * Kin/rIn + thetaOut * Kout/rOut + thetaM * Mhat
nesting: thetaIn = thetaK * rIn / rK and thetaOut = thetaK * rOut / rK, same gamma, thetaM, and shell.

coefficient_distance.definition: normalized_distance = |thetaIn/rIn - thetaOut/rOut| * rIn * rOut / rK. This is the RMS of the K-coefficient residual from the span of FK, divided by RMS(J). Kin and Kout are disjoint, so the identity is exact. Do not divide by thetaOut or form thetaIn/thetaOut.

branch_screen.meaning: If both depths improve stored Rfull energy by less than 0.005 and the coefficient distance is at most 0.001, the split has not left the nested family. That retires a new-candidate claim. It is not a seal and not an impossibility proof.

robust_screen.meaning: A fresh-median gap above 0.03 at both L5 and L6 flags the fresh arm. Medians use every finished start. This is not a proof that full K is necessary.

Rfull_fresh.role: equal-budget control, same caps and start count, no stored angle

KS_nested.role: stored Rfull embedded at the same depth

knots: x_l=(l+0.5)/L. Linear below 3 source layers, natural cubic otherwise, constant clamp outside the source knots.

qaoa.floor: round4_N same-hash jobs, replayed before use. Strong published p9-p12 floats are the round4_V 256-start rows in baseline.json.
qaoa.rescue_if_both_metric_win: up to 4 times the winning cell marginal start count, at the matched p, the next p, and p12, and only while time remains

amortization: The campaign total is the sum of marginal nfev in this run plus the external source nfev of files actually consumed. Inclusive for a cell is its marginal nfev plus the marginal nfev of the cells that produced its seeds. A shared ladder is listed on each consumer and added once in the campaign total. Round4 QAOA nfev is a same-hash floor, not a second copy of this run.
objective: energy only. Fidelity is reported for the energy-selected state and is not used to select.
